The description covers two items, but the task asks for a single code. Item 1 (two-seat beach chair with umbrella and storage compartment, in one box for retail sale as a unit) is the more distinctive item, and the umbrella and collapsible seating point to chairs of textile construction. Under HTSUS, camping/beach chairs with metal frames and textile seats are classified under heading 9401.71 or 9401.79 (seats with metal frames, upholstered/not upholstered). Since item 1's structure (collapsible metal frame, textile seating) fits 9401.71 for upholstered/ textile-covered seats with metal frames, the appropriate subheading is 9401.71.00 for upholstered seats with metal frames, with the statistical suffix 9401.71.0000 applied.
